title: TRX 15m : textbook-looking cup and handle, but the whole thing is only 1% tall
author: FarInspector1873
selftext:
TRX/USDT, 15m (Oct 28–29).

This one looks almost too clean. A rounded cup from 0.3315 down to about 0.3285 and back, then a small handle dipping near 0.3307, and price is now sitting right back at the 0.3315 neckline.

My problem is the size. The whole pattern is roughly 1% tall. On a pair as liquid as TRX that's tiny, and after fees and spread there isn't much room left even if it breaks cleanly.

Volume also isn't telling me much. The heaviest bars were on the way down into the cup and the push out of the bottom, and the handle has been quiet.

So how do you treat patterns this small on a big, liquid coin? Do you ignore them, wait for a bigger timeframe, or just use them as a short-term guide?

Just sharing the chart, not a call.
